inventory_items_business_core_qid_key.name: inventory_items_business_core_qid_key
inventory_items_business_core_qid_key.where: core_qid is not null and archived_at is null

inventory_items_business_barcode_key.name: inventory_items_business_barcode_key
inventory_items_business_barcode_key.where: barcode is not null and archived_at is null

vision_detections_counts_nonneg.name: vision_detections_counts_nonneg
vision_detections_counts_nonneg.value: spark_count >= 0 and count >= 0 and (sam_count is null or sam_count >= 0)

vision_detections_inventory_match.name: vision_detections_inventory_match
vision_detections_inventory_match.value: (inventory_item_id is null) = (inventory_match is null) and (inventory_match is null or inventory_match in ('reading', 'catalogue', 'name'))

vision_detections_review_length.name: vision_detections_review_length
vision_detections_review_length.value: review is null or char_length(review) between 1 and 500

vision_detections_catalog_resolution.name: vision_detections_catalog_resolution
vision_detections_catalog_resolution.value: (catalog_resolution is null) = (catalog_resolved_at is null) and (catalog_resolution is null or catalog_resolution in ('created', 'linked', 'dismissed'))

vision_detections_action.name: vision_detections_action
vision_detections_action.value: action is null or action in ('restock', 'restore', 'add', 'skip')

vision_detections_outcome.name: vision_detections_outcome
vision_detections_outcome.value: outcome is null or outcome in ('accepted', 'corrected', 'new_item', 'removed')

vision_detections_decision_consistent.name: vision_detections_decision_consistent
vision_detections_decision_consistent.value:
(action is null) = (decided_at is null) and (action is null) = (outcome is null) and (action is null) = (decided_by is null)
        and (action = 'skip') = (outcome = 'removed') and (action is distinct from 'skip') = (item_id is not null or action is null)
